content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (NOSOLICIT)**

The non-solicitation covenant in Article X(b) (¶p0125) fails the fallback on two material terms and reaches walk-away territory:

| Term | As drafted | Fallback requires |
|---|---|---|
| Mutuality | One-way — binds Licensee only | Mutual |
| Duration | 3 years post-expiration/termination | 12 months from end of involvement |
| Scope | All persons employed by Licensor **and/or its Affiliates** | Only personnel directly involved in the services |
| Carve-outs | Present and adequate ✓ | General ads + unsolicited approaches |
| No-hire | None ✓ | No "no-hire" |

The clause's definition of "Solicit" already excludes general job advertising, follow-up with responders, and voluntary inquiries, and there is no no-hire component — so the redline preserves that sentence untouched and makes only the three minimal edits needed to reach the fallback (mutual / involved personnel / 12 months). Validated `ok:true`, keyed to precedent `seed-nosolicit`.

One item noted for information rather than flagged: the injunctive-relief provision (¶p0126) still entitles Licensor alone to equitable relief for "Non Solicitation of Licensor Employees," which sits oddly with a now-mutual covenant. That is a conforming-change point, not an independent breach of this rule.
